title: Greed of You
description: This  mod adds more goodies and surprises to your world to change things up, including ores, structures, mobs and unique armors and tools that buff the player
body:
Greed of you is a mod that plans to add new structures, armor, blocks, ore and enemies to the game, taking a different approach to how the player can power up with armors and tools through unique set-bonuses/individual armor piece buffs

I plan on releasing the mod to other versions but please be patient because its not my priority

I took inspiration from mods including Voidscape and Orespawn and the name "Greed of You" symbolises the greed of the minecraft player, always wanting things like the "end update" to be added to the game

Currently in the mod:
Umbrenite Ore and Block,
Umbrenite Tools, Sword and Armor, 
Quirky advancements 👌🤔
And... more to come!
